caption: The drawing depicts a wooden panel with two vertical posts at either end, rendered in shades of brown to simulate wood grain. The central section of the panel is adorned with a carved figure of a bird with an upright head and outstretched wings, positioned on a stylized base that appears to represent clouds or rocks. The wings are detailed with individual feathers. Both bottom corners of the panel are cut out in semicircular shapes, creating symmetrical indentations. The background of the drawing is a light beige color, which contrasts with the detailed brown coloration and texture of the resulting wood objects. The drawing is composed symmetrically and focuses on the central bird motif.
title: Headboard
